name: Ukraine

what: Full-scale invasion, now a grinding war of attrition
when: Started Feb 24, 2022 — day 1,650+ and still going

current: The six-day localized ceasefire in the Kherson region has ended, with the area bracing for a return to active combat despite no reported violations during the truce. On the military front, Ukrainian drones reportedly attacked a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland, marking the first such strike on a Russian vessel in open sea.
